If the deal fails i will put the server back to the previous specs until i find another candidate for migration.

items.title: 📣 Information 📣
items.body:
Please notice the world lower height limit will change from Y - 320 to Y-64 on wednesday 14/10/26 during 14:00 restart

This will allow us to free a good part of the server's resources and improve the TPS as we now have more active players.

This will have a few implications:

  • everything below Y -64 will be erased
  • there won't be a bedrock layer anymore in already generated chunks, i can eventually fix this with world edit or command blocks but it will take some time
  • there will be some weird generation gaps between already generated chunks and new ones

For the moment, we will leave the high limit to + 620 as it doesn't impact performance as much (mostly just air)

🔴 If you have any structure/farm/machine below Y-64 please consider moving it above that level so that we will be ready for the change.
Please also consider that Y-64 itself will need to be free to be replaced with bedrock, make sure any block you place starts from -63

items.title: Diamonds are "easy" to get with farms but it can be a good scale as we can use them for lower tier items, scaling the…
items.body:
Diamonds are "easy" to get with farms but it can be a good scale as we can use them for lower tier items, scaling them for high tier items.

A general idea of what items may be worth:

1 stack of construction blocks may be valued at 1 copper coin
1 stack of redstone may be worth 2-3 copper coins
an high end item like a meka suit may require up to 500 netherite coins, meaning it is easy to get values of millions of diamonds without making cheap items too costly

Remember the economy will be player driven so in the end it is you that will make the prices, knowing that each copper coin costs you 1 diamond, each netherite coin costs you 100.000 diamonds.

Please keep in mind i'm adding these mods to check possibilities as anticipated in general chat.
Feel free to let me know what you think.

items.title: 📝 Changelog 30/09/2026 (2:00 PM Server restart)
items.body:
Introducing economy mods as a test keeping an eye open for any possible misuse/game boosting/progress skipping.

Wiki: https://github.com/Lightman314/LightmansCurrency/wiki

🔵 General info

There will be 6 coin tiers. (phisical items)

📝 Tiers:

copper
iron
gold
emerald
diamond
netherite

each coin is made with 10 coins of the previous tier
Example: 1 iron coin is 10 copper coins

Coins can be stored in wallets (curios slot), money chests or ATM (bank accounts)

Players can place phisical shops (vending machines or others) where they can sell or buy items.
it is possible to restock shops with machines

With these shops it will be possible to sell/buy items, armors, weapons, energy, fluids, tickets for areas and even sell or rent land.

🔴 Inflation (server taxes)

To control the quantity and thus the value of coins, there will not be an initial balance and the coins cannot be gathered in chests/looted from mobs and a server tax will be subtracted from the selling price of every sale.

Current server tax is set at 11%

The only source of new coins will be a server shop that will be created at spawn, it will sell copper coins at a price of 1 diamond for each coin.

By doing so, these are the values of the coins:

1 copper coin --> 1 diamond
1 iron coin --> 10 diamonds
1 gold coin --> 100 diamonds
1 emerald coin --> 1000 diamonds
1 diamond coin --> 10.000 diamonds
1 netherite coin --> 100.000 diamonds

The pattern will work fine in your AE2.

items.title: 📣 Ranks!📣
items.body:
If you join today you will notice i've reimplemented ranks.

We currently have these ranks:

🟢 Recruit (given as soon as you start playing)
Possibility to set 1 home (standard)
Standard /home cooldown (10s)
Standard /back cooldown (30s)
Standard /rtp cooldown (10 minutes)
🔵 Member (given after 1 day of playtime)
Possibility to set 1 home (standard)
/home cooldown (5s)
/back cooldown (20s)
/rtp cooldown (7.5 minutes)

🟡 VIP (given after 1 week of playtime)
Possibility to set 2 homes
/home cooldown (0s)
/back cooldown (10s)
/rtp cooldown (5 minutes)

This is of course a first implementation of ranks.
More will follow
As always feel free to contact me for suggestions
